lines.ref:
I needed that lesson
to grow.

"Everyone is so much
better than me"

I'm only in competition
with myself.

shots.brief: Person leaning on railing looking serious or contemplative indoors (ref: Young man leaning on an indoor balcony railing, looking thoughtfully into the distance with a serious expression.; tripod)
Person outdoors looking serious or brooding in profile (ref: Young man standing on a beach at sunset, looking away toward the horizon with a solemn expression.; tripod)
Person sitting at a desk looking down or defeated (ref: Young man sitting at a classroom desk with arms folded, head lowered in a discouraged posture.; tripod)

special: Matched pairs of clips in identical locations and outfits: one looking somber/contemplative and one smiling/laughing at the camera
audit.notes: This format depends entirely on matched 'before and after' pairs: a serious/downcast expression cut directly to a cheerful smiling reaction in the exact same spot and outfit. A general B-roll library rarely contains deliberate pairs of opposite emotions in identical scenes.
audit.summary: Three pairs of clips contrasting a negative thought with a positive mindset reframe. In each pair, the creator is seen in the same location looking pensive or defeated, followed by a cut where he smiles warmly at the camera.
